links.outcome: Expert-scored clinical knowledge accuracy of LLM answers on tremor-related diseases
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1-671B scored 9.1 ± 0.33, Doubao-1.5-pro-256k 6.8 ± 1.65, Moonshot-v1-128k-vision-preview 4.9 ± 1.02 (P < 0.05); one potentially harmful treatment response from Moonshot.
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1-671B demonstrated the best performance (mean score 9.1 ± 0.33), significantly outperforming Doubao-1.5-pro-256k (6.8 ± 1.65) and Moonshot-v1-128k-vision-preview (4.9 ± 1.02) (P < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the medical capability, accuracy, and safety of three mainstream Chinese LLMs across complex tremor-related questions using expert scoring, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
